presentation.title: Lift and hot water failure
lines: The lift and the hot water have broken in the same week.

choices.label: Pay $2,400 for an emergency repair
choices.outcome: Engineers fix it today and the rooms stay on sale.

choices.label: Book the scheduled technician for $700
choices.outcome: It is cheaper, but the affected rooms are off sale for six days.
